caption_es:
Casi la mitad de los planes de tratamiento aceptados nunca se completan.

No es un problema de lectura. Es lo que pasa entre el sillón y el mesón de recepción.

En el carrusel: dónde se abre esa brecha y qué la cierra, según 57 profesionales dentales que entrevistamos.

¿Cómo lo manejan en tu clínica? Te leo abajo.

Fuente: Dental Intelligence Practice Benchmarks.

#odontologia #DSO #gestiondental #tecnologiadental
commentary_en:
Nearly half of accepted treatment plans are never completed.

That is not a reading problem. It opens between the chair and the front desk — and most practices have no system that owns it.

We interviewed 57 dental professionals about where the gap opens and what closes it. The five slides below are what we heard.

Curious how emerging DSOs are handling this today. Comments open.

Source: Dental Intelligence Practice Benchmarks.
title_en: The follow-up gap in dental treatment acceptance
